BOOK ONE · LESSON 122

Who (whom), which and that 关系代词

关系代词

A picture lesson introducing relative pronouns who, whom, which and that. Nine numbered pictures illustrate relative clauses: who served you (the man/woman behind the counter), who is making all that noise (the men repairing the road), who(m)/that I served yesterday (the man/woman/men), which/that book(s) on the counter, and which dog is yours (the dog carrying that basket). The written exercises rewrite sentences with who, whom or which and write questions and answers. The grammar workbook drills combining sentences with which/that and who/whom/that.

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

听录音并回答问题。

Nine pictures (1-9): 1 Who served you? The man who/that is standing behind the counter. 2 Who served you? The woman who/that is standing behind the counter. 3 Who is making all that noise? The men who/that are repairing the road. 4 I served him yesterday. He is the man who(m)/that I served yesterday. 5 I served her yesterday. She is the woman who(m)/that I served yesterday. 6 I saw them yesterday. They are the men who(m)/that I saw yesterday. 7 Which book did you buy? The book which/that is on the counter. 8 Which books did you buy? The books which/that are on the counter. 9 Which dog is yours? The dog which/that is carrying that basket.

九张图片（1-9）：1 谁接待了您？站在柜台后面的那位男士。2 谁接待了您？站在柜台后面的那位女士。3 是谁弄出这么大的响声？那些正在修路的男士们。4 我昨天接待了他。他就是我昨天接待的那位男士。5 我昨天接待了她。她就是我昨天接待的那位女士。6 我昨天见到了他们。他们就是我昨天见到的那些男士。7 您买了哪本书？就是柜台上的那本书。8 您买了哪几本书？就是柜台上的那几本书。9 哪条狗是您的？就是叼着那只篮子的那条狗。
